text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I enter my office, I spot a piece of paper left on my desk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "I'll be waiting in the gym! Signed, the class representative!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! I've been waiting for you! I hope you've braced yourself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Did I do something wrong? Am I going to get scolded? Trembling slightly, I prepare myself…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: You demonstrated outstanding leadership, and helped me polish my skills!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That's right! Thanks to you, even my Bakushin has reached new levels!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: So allow me to show you the true meaning of Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hehe… I might be an elite among model students, but you are a trainer among trainers!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: This letter embodies my respect for you… It's a letter of commendation! Please take it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To think I'd receive such a heart-warming letter from this unpredictable girl… The letter of commendation brings a tear to my eye.
